_comment: llama-mon config for lucifer (systemd, Radeon RX 7900 XTX at PCI 0000:0b:00.0 + a Quadro P2000 at 0000:04:00.0). Install: copy to /etc/llama-mon/config.json BEFORE running local/systemd/install.sh, or run the installer first and let it seed then overwrite; either way the installer never clobbers an existing /etc config. Precedence: defaults < this file < MON_* env.
_gpus_comment: Both cards visible: Radeon RX 7900 XTX at 0000:0b:00.0 and Quadro P2000 at 0000:04:00.0 (BDFs survive card-number reshuffles; 'amd:card1' / nvidia index would not be boot-stable). To hide the P2000 again, drop its entry from gpus.
_throttle_comment: Above 10 c/kWh -> driver minimum cap (sysfs power1_cap_min = 294 W on this card, read live, no low_watts needed). At/below -> restore_watts. 'default' would map to power1_cap_max (350 W) because AMD sysfs has no factory-default value, but this AIB card's intended default is the 327 W it reports when unthrottled, so pin it explicitly.
_throttle_devices_comment: Only the 7900 XTX runs inference here, so only it is throttled. If the Quadro P2000 should join, append { "gpu": "0000:04:00.0", "restore_watts": "default" } - on NVIDIA 'default' is exact (driver power.default_limit, 75 W on a P2000) and the cheap-hours floor becomes its power.min_limit.
